A '''Seed''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' which is used to create an ''[[angreal]]''. The crafter uses the ''ter'angreal'' to pour the [[One Power]] for a very long period into an empty vessel. The process is said to greatly weaken the channeler that created the ''angreal'' for several months.

Just prior to the [[Last Battle]] [[Rand al'Thor]] gave a Seed to [[Elayne Trakand]], as his last gift, revealing to her the existence of such items and how to use them. The one she is given takes the form of a small statue of a woman standing upright, with a shawl about her shoulders, though she does not look like an Aes Sedai. The woman has a mature face, aged and wise, with a wise look about her and a smile on her face.{{ref/book|14|9}}

==Trivia==
It is possible that Sanderson meant this to be a cameo of [[Harriet McDougal]] to mirror Jordan's appearance as the [[Bearded man]] library ''ter'angreal''. Is true that Harriet could be called the seed of much of The Wheel of Time and the process of creating an ''angreal'' would be analogous to the writing of a long novel, sapping the energy of the author for many months.
